/* cppi::ad48dd8f86f8bd1b948e36788d45ebdf8a9788f77e68de73439659c30eb96eb2 */
with cte as
(
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SEDOL ORDER BY (CASE WHEN cppib_sec_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 2 END), cppib_sec_id) AS rn
    FROM asset.asset_equity
    where business_date = date'2025-06-26'
)
select
    eq.business_date,
    'IR_EQ_Benchmark' as benchmark_name,
    eq.cell_name as category,
    null as id_cppib_index,
    'tfm_bp_eq_benchmark' as feed_name,
    null as index_name,
    cte.instrument_name as security_name,
    'Equity' as asset_type,
    cte.sedol as sedol,
    cte.cusip as cusip,
    cte.isin as isin,
    ms.type,
    ms.sub_type,
    eq.local_price as last_value_eod,
    eq.local_price as last_value_ndo,
    eq.benchmark_weight as weight_eod,
    eq.benchmark_weight as weight_ndo,
    p.party_name as issuer_name,
    cte.cppib_sec_id as id_cppib_security,
    cte.currency_code as iso_currency_eod,
    cte.country_code as country_domicile,
    cte.listing_country_code as country_listing,
    cte.region_code as region,
    ms.cppib_market_capitalization_size_code as market_capitalization_size_code,
    cte.country_code as country_reference_code_eod,
    eq.benchmark_weight as benchmark_constituent_weight,
    null as sub_component,
    sr.rating_value as security_rating,
    pr.rating_value as issuer_rating,
    null as developed_market_flag,
    ms.cppib_sector_classification_code_1 as classification_code_1,
    ms.cppib_sector_classification_name_1 as classification_code_1_description,
    ms.cppib_sector_classification_code_2 as classification_code_2,
    ms.cppib_sector_classification_name_2 as classification_code_2_description,
    ms.cppib_sector_classification_code_3 as classification_code_3,
    ms.cppib_sector_classification_name_3 as classification_code_3_description,
    ms.cppib_sector_classification_code_4 as classification_code_4,
    ms.cppib_sector_classification_name_4 as classification_code_4_description,
    null as alternate_listing,
    rc.country_name,
    null as market_capitalization_base_eod,
    cte.shares_outstanding_real as investable_shares_eod,
    cte.trade_currency_code as iso_currency_local,
    null as quality,
    null as maturity_bucket
from market.tfm_bp_eq_benchmark eq
left join cte
    on eq.business_date = cte.business_date and eq.sedol = cte.sedol and cte.rn = 1
left join asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications ms
    on cte.cppib_sec_id = ms.cppib_sec_id and eq.business_date = ms.business_date
left join asset.asset_security_ratings sr
    on cte.cppib_sec_id = sr.cppib_sec_id and eq.business_date = sr.business_date and sr.rating_agency = 'CPPIB'
left join asset.asset_security_party_relationship spr
    on cte.cppib_sec_id = spr.cppib_sec_id and cte.business_date = spr.business_date and spr.role = 'ISSUER'
left join party.party p
    on spr.cppib_party_id = p.cppib_party_id and eq.business_date = p.business_date
left join party.party_ratings pr
    on spr.cppib_party_id = pr.cppib_party_id and eq.business_date = pr.business_date and pr.rating_agency = 'CPPIB'
left join reference.reference_country_codes rc 
    on rc.country_code = cte.country_code and eq.business_date = rc.business_date
where eq.business_date = date'2025-06-26'

SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "period_sorted"
FROM (with scd_perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y Rolling'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
			from
				performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (

					and scd.split_level = 0 
				)
				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF' )
					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'

			, 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency

			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y

			, pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency

			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency

		from

	) perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'

			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency

			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]

			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

    NULL                                                     AS created_by,
    NULL                                                     AS date_updated,

    securities.business_date                                 AS sentry_security_src_business_date,
    --------------------------------------
    -- comment and error

    --------------------------------------
    -- investigate these
    --------------------------------------
    NULL                                                     AS investment_program,
    NULL                                                     AS investment_strategy,
    NULL                                                     AS investment_group,
    NULL                                                     AS tfm_inv_sub_strategy,
    --------------------------------------
    -- helpful debug information
    --------------------------------------
    transactions.transaction_code                            AS transaction_code,
    'credit_investment_private_trusted_uat.cashflows_all_transactions, reference_uat.ci_sentry_security'               AS data_sources_list
    --------------------------------------
    ,transactions.txn_id
FROM
    credit_investment_private_trusted_uat.cashflows_all_transactions transactions
LEFT JOIN
    reference_uat.ci_sentry_security securities
ON
    transactions.security_identifier = securities.security_identifier
WHERE
    CAST(transactions.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-26' AS DATE)
AND
    CAST(securities.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-26' AS DATE)
AND
    TRY_CAST('2025-06-26' AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE (securities.start_date) AND DATE(securities.end_date)
--AND
--  TRY_CAST(transactions.trade_date AS DATE) >= TRY_CAST('2025-06-26' AS DATE)
-- TODO: confirm if this is just because there is no underlying data
-- or there is problem in the logic
AND transactions.transaction_type = 'transaction'
AND transactions.is_cancelled = 'False'
--AND settlement_date = ''
--AND transactions.transaction_code NOT IN (SELECT code FROM excluded_transaction_codes)    -- Filter out the transaction codes that should be excluded
AND transactions.txn_id =   11073731

SELECT

	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 27
		AND hour between 17 and 18
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-27 17:28:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT a.node,
       (a.analytic_value - b.analytic_value) AS var_difference,
       a.analytic_value AS current_var
FROM rmv_analytics a
JOIN rmv_analytics b ON a.node = b.node
  AND a.hierarchy_level  = 'STRATEGY'
  AND b.hierarchy_level  = 'STRATEGY'
WHERE a.business_date = '2025-03-31'
  AND b.business_date = '2024-12-31'
  AND a.analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR'
  AND b.analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR'
  AND a.confidence_level = 0.95
  AND b.confidence_level = 0.95
  AND a.methodology = 'RISK_METRICS'
  AND b.methodology = 'RISK_METRICS'
  AND a.portfolio_type = 'IP'
  AND b.portfolio_type = 'IP'
ORDER BY a.strategy ASC

/* cppi::39fc92a94ca303d8fe6dd6d9a9f1488130e6e795a328bbcfa88b5b2a7279538f */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 27
		AND hour between 12 and 13
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-27 12:38:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT

	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 27
		AND hour between 19 and 20
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-27 19:48:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

    from cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite
    where business_date <= date'2025-03-31'
),

classification_secno as (
    select inst_id, cppib_sector_classification_name_1 as industry_sector_name
    from cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite class
    join risk_uat.dim_inst i
        on i.security_number = class.abor_security_number
        and i.business_date = cast(class.business_date as varchar)
    where class.enterprise_security_source = 'SCD'
        and i.business_date = cast((select max_date from max_business_date) as varchar)

    union

    select inst_id, cppib_sector_classification_name_1 as industry_sector_name
    from cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite class
    join risk_uat.dim_inst i
        on i.cppib_security_id = cast(class.cppib_sec_id as varchar)
        and i.business_date = cast(class.business_date as varchar)
    where class.enterprise_security_source = 'EEM'
        and i.business_date = cast((select max_date from max_business_date) as varchar)
)
select dpi.business_date,
        (
			case
				when dpi.portfolio_type in ('IP', 'CASH_FOR_BENEFIT', 'ACPP_CFB') then dpi.pos_source_system_key
				when dpi.portfolio_type = 'INDEX_LOOKTHROUGH' then replace(dpi.pos_source_system_key, 'CPPSECID')
				when dpi.portfolio_type = 'LOOKTHROUGH' and position('OFFSET' in dpi.pos_source_system_key) > 0 then dpi.pos_source_system_key
				else concat(substr(dpi.pos_source_system_key, 1, position('_' in dpi.pos_source_system_key)-1), '_', dpi.pos_short_desc)
			end 
		) as "position_key",
		dpi.portfolio_type,
		c.abacus_notional_base_ccy,
        c.abacus_notional_local_ccy,
        c.abacus_pv_base_ccy,
        c.abacus_pv_base_ccy * fx.mid_val as abacus_pv_local_ccy,
        c.rm_pv,
        dpi.long_short,
        (
            case
                when i_rle.cppib_party_id is not null then i_rle.cppib_party_id
                when l1_rle.cppib_party_id is not null then l1_rle.cppib_party_id
                when mi_rle.cppib_party_id is not null then mi_rle.cppib_party_id
                else null
            end
        ) as issuer_cppib_party_id,
        (
            case 
                when i_rle.party_name is not null then i_rle.party_name
                when l1_rle.party_name is not null then l1_rle.party_name
                when mi_rle.party_name is not null then mi_rle.party_name
                else null
            end
        ) as issuer_party_name,
        (
            case 
                when i_rle.gics_sector is not null then i_rle.gics_sector
                when l1_rle.gics_sector is not null then l1_rle.gics_sector 
                when cl.industry_sector_name is not null then cl.industry_sector_name
                when mi_rle.gics_sector is not null then mi_rle.gics_sector
                else null
            end
        ) as issuer_gics_sector,
        (
            case 
                when i_rle.gics_industry is not null then i_rle.gics_industry
                when l1_rle.gics_industry is not null then l1_rle.gics_industry
                --when cl.industry_sector_name is not null then cl.industry_sector_name
                when mi_rle.gics_industry is not null then mi_rle.gics_industry
                else null
            end
        ) as issuer_gics_industry,
        (
            case 
                when i_rle.gics_industry_group is not null then i_rle.gics_industry_group
                when l1_rle.gics_industry_group is not null then l1_rle.gics_industry_group
                --when cl.industry_sector_name is not null then cl.industry_sector_name
                when mi_rle.gics_industry_group is not null then mi_rle.gics_industry_group
                else null
            end
        ) as issuer_gics_industry_group,
        (
            case 
                when i_rle.gics_sub_industry is not null then i_rle.gics_sub_industry
                when l1_rle.gics_sub_industry is not null then l1_rle.gics_sub_industry
                --when cl.industry_sector_name is not null then cl.industry_sector_name
                when mi_rle.gics_sub_industry is not null then mi_rle.gics_sub_industry
                else null
            end
        ) as issuer_gics_sub_industry,
        (
            case 
                when i_rle.secm_exposure_country is not null then i_rle.secm_exposure_country
                when l1_rle.secm_exposure_country is not null then l1_rle.secm_exposure_country 
                when mi_rle.secm_exposure_country is not null then mi_rle.secm_exposure_country
                else null
            end
        ) as issuer_country_of_exposure,
        (
            case 
                when dpi.ticker is not null then dpi.ticker 
                when inst1.ticker is not null then inst1.ticker 
                else inst2.ticker
            end
        ) as bloomberg_ticker,
        i_rle.incorp_country_code,
        cp_rle.cppib_party_id as cp_cppib_party_id,
        cp_rle.party_name as cp_party_name,
        cp_rle.gics_sector as cp_gics_sector,
        cp_rle.gics_industry as cp_gics_industry,
        cp_rle.gics_industry_group as cp_gics_industry_group,
        cp_rle.gics_sub_industry as cp_gics_sub_industry,
        cp_rle.secm_exposure_country as cp_secm_exposure_country,
        dpi.ptfl_acct_code as scd_model_portfolio,
        mp.unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code,
        h.investment_dept,
        h.investment_strat,
        h.program,
        h.sub_program,
        acc.investment_dept as account_investment_dept,
        acc.investment_strat as account_investment_strat,
        dpi.cppib_security_id,
        (
            case 
                when dpi.isin is not null then dpi.isin 
                when inst1.isin is not null then inst1.isin
                else inst2.isin
            end
        ) as isin,
        (
            case 
                when dpi.sedol is not null then dpi.sedol 
                when inst1.sedol is not null then inst1.sedol
                else inst2.sedol
            end
        ) as sedol,
        (
            case 
                when dpi.cusip is not null then dpi.cusip 
                when inst1.cusip is not null then inst1.cusip
                else inst2.cusip
            end
        ) as cusip,
        dpi.local_currency_iso_code,
        dpi.maturity_date,
        main_inst.cppib_security_id as main_cpp_sec,
        main_inst.coupon_type,
        main_inst.mds_coupon_type,
        main_inst.coupon_frequency,
        main_inst.coupon_frequency_unit,
        main_inst.float_spread,
        main_inst.floating_rate_spread_percent,
        main_inst.coupon_rate,
        main_inst.reference_rate_value,
        main_inst.coupon,
        dpi.pos_short_desc as position_description,
        dpi.cppib_product_type as product_type,
        dpi.security_group_name as product_group,
        dpi.inst_type_name as position_data_source,
        dpi.inst_type  as inst_inst_type,
        dpi.secgrp,
        dpi.sectype,
        dpi.qty as quantity,
        dpi.mkt_spot_price,
        cpr.rating_value as issuer_rating,
        ccpr.rating_value as cp_rating,
        csr.rating_value as inst_final_rating,
        c.abacus_accrued_interest_pc,
        dpi.murex_contract, 
        dpi.murex_reference_id,
        dpi.murex_sstref,
        dpi.murex_portfolio,
        dpi.local_currency_fcp as future_cashflow_local,
        coalesce((1 / fx.mid_val), 1) * dpi.local_currency_fcp as future_cashflow_base
from risk_uat.dim_pos_inst dpi
left join finance_accounting.model_portfolios mp
    on mp.id_model_portfolio = dpi.ptfl_acct_code and cast(mp.business_date as varchar) = dpi.business_date
left join risk_uat.fact_pos_calc_sd c on c.pos_id = dpi.pos_id 
left join risk_uat.mv_dim_hierarchy_node_risk h on h.dim_hierarchy_node_id = c.dim_hierarchy_node_id
left join risk_uat.dim_inst main_inst on main_inst.inst_id = dpi.inst_id
left join risk_uat.dim_inst inst1 on inst1.inst_id = dpi.inst1_id 
left join risk_uat.dim_inst inst2 on inst2.inst_id = dpi.inst2_id
left join classification_secno cl on cl.inst_id = main_inst.inst_id
left join risk_uat.ref_legal_entity i_rle on i_rle.legal_entity_id = dpi.issuer_id
left join risk_uat.ref_legal_entity cp_rle on cp_rle.legal_entity_id = dpi.counter_party_id
left join risk_uat.ref_legal_entity l1_rle on inst1.issuer_id = l1_rle.legal_entity_id
left join risk_uat.ref_legal_entity mi_rle on main_inst.issuer_id = mi_rle.legal_entity_id
left join risk_uat.cppib_security_rating csr on cast(csr.cppib_sec_id as varchar) = dpi.cppib_security_id and csr.business_date = dpi.business_date
left join risk_uat.cppib_party_rating cpr on cpr.cppib_party_id = i_rle.cppib_party_id and cpr.business_date = dpi.business_date
left join risk_uat.cppib_party_rating ccpr on ccpr.cppib_party_id = cp_rle.cppib_party_id and ccpr.business_date = dpi.business_date
left join risk_uat.mv_dim_hierarchy_node_account acc on acc.dim_hierarchy_node_id = c.dim_hierarchy_node_id
left join risk_uat.fact_fx_rate fx on dpi.local_currency_iso_code = fx.to_currency
            and fx.from_currency = 'CAD'
		    and fx.rate_type = 'CROSS'
		    and dpi.business_date = fx.business_date
where c.business_date = '2025-03-31'
and dpi.holkeyik in (select holkeyik from risk_prod.dim_pos_inst where business_date = '2025-03-31' and secgrp in ('SYN CR IDX', 'SYN FI IDX'))
and inst_type_name = 'index_lookthrough'
and dpi.portfolio_type = 'INDEX_LOOKTHROUGH'

      AND dn.node_level = 2

/* cppi::2890e47f11b9e57b925ed273a36f08c37e30309aadb4e82b4e6b48947bdb5591 */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 27
		AND hour between 07 and 08
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-27 07:23:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

FROM (with asset_class_base as (

		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'

		, case
			when metric like '%_rc' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_lc' then 'Local'

		, case
			when metric like '%_qtd_%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%_3m_%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%_fytd_%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%_1y_roll_%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%_4yp_%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%_5y_roll_%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, node_name

			, time_weighted_return_rc
			, time_weighted_return_lc

			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc

			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			, last_update 
		from 
			performance_dev.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where
			dataset_id = 'ASSETCL_CMB'
			and periods_per_year = 12
			and "level" = 1
			and node_name != 'Excluded' -- Per Michael Brown from Performance team, the Excluded node should be excluded from reporting
	) pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_rc
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
		  ]
	) unpivot ( metric, value )
), asset_class_clean as (
	select
		  asset_class_base.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, cast( format( '%1$tY%1$tm%1$td', business_date ) as int ) as business_date_int
		, date_format( business_date, '%Y-%m' ) as year_month
		--, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', calendar_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from
		asset_class_base
	where
		business_date >= cast( '2019-04-01' as date )
		/*and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD', '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) )
		and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) )*/
)
select * from asset_class_clean) AS "finsights_perf_returns_asset_class_DEV"

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 27
		AND hour between 05 and 06
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-27 05:58:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* cppi::810f71e7f27721885af91fcbc15ab3ef5cbdb4c69ffb45366aebd8897803094c */
WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-06-26')               AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE))   AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-06-26')
          AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
          AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_re_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                    InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Real Estate'
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Listed Real Estate')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel6 IN ('Portfolio Enhancement DM', 'Portfolio Enhancement EM')
                AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')
                 OR model_portfolio IN ('')
            )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_re_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings_uat.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 asset.security_name,
                 asset.bloomberg_code
    )

SELECT
    (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)                    AS "Start Date",
    perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id                           AS "BB Unique ID - Current",
    perf_data.security_name                                 AS "Security Name - Current",
    perf_data.bloomberg_code                                AS "Bloomberg Code - Current",
    perf_data.model_portfolio                               AS "Model Portfolio Code",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_start                         AS "Total Market Value QC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_quotation_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow QC",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_end                           AS "Total Market Value QC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_quotation_currency  AS "Total PnL QC",
    perf_data.market_value_pc_start                         AS "Total Market Value PC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_reporting_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow PC",
    perf_data.market_value_pc_end                           AS "Total Market Value PC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency - perf_seclvl.period_result_node_by_node_local AS "FX PnL PC",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency  AS "Total PnL PC"
FROM perf_data
INNER JOIN performance_uat.scd_performance_seclvl perf_seclvl
        ON perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_1 = perf_data.model_portfolio
       AND perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_3 = perf_data.bloomberg_code
       AND CAST(perf_seclvl.business_date AS DATE) = DATE('2025-06-26')
ORDER BY perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id,
         perf_data.bloomberg_code

SELECT ds.* FROM ( WITH
    listed_ra_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name,
            InvestmentStructureLevel5
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                InvestmentStructureLevel3 IN ('Infrastructure','Real Estate','Sustainable Energy Group')
                  AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure','Listed Real Estate','Power and Renewables Group')
                  AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM','Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM','Power Generation')
                  AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')
                   OR model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104','MPRSBE0', 'MPR1000279', 'MPR1000328', 'MPR1000200', 'MPAR100041')
                )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
    ),
    latest_trans AS (
        SELECT trans.*, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY trans.abor_security_number, trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key
                    ORDER BY trans.changed_date DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions trans
        WHERE trans.transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
        --  AND trans.requested_transaction_status = 'Final GL'
          AND trans.reconciliation_status = 'Reconcilable'
          AND trans.business_transaction_code in ('Sell','CASell','SellInternal','Buy','CABuy','BuyInternal','CapRed','Exchange Offer','Dividend','Rights Distribution','GenCost')
          AND CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
    ),
    latest_finance_trans AS (
        SELECT fin.*, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key, fin.finance_transaction_index
                    ORDER BY fin.extract_time DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM finance_accounting.scd_finance_transactions fin
        WHERE fin.finance_scheme LIKE '%EQTY%'
          AND fin.accounting_framework_id = 'MAIN'
          AND fin.gl_account_name != 'CASH BALANCE'
          AND fin.gl_account_name NOT LIKE '%DUE%'
          AND fin.booking_type != 'Payment reconciliation'
    ),
    trans AS (
        SELECT
            trans.trade_date                        AS business_date,
            trans.model_portfolio_id                AS model_portfolio_id,
            sec.bloomberg_unique_id                 AS bb_unique_id,
            CASE
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'Sell ROC'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%TRNS BRKR COMM COST%' THEN 'Sell Costs'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%REALIZED%' THEN 'Sell GL'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Buy','BuyInternal','CABuy','Exchange Offer') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'Net Purchase'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Buy','BuyInternal','CABuy') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%TRNS BRKR COMM COST%' THEN 'Purchase Costs'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Dividend') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%DIVIDEND INC%' THEN 'Gross Dividend'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Dividend') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%TAX EXP%' THEN 'Dividend Taxes'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('CapRed') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'CapRd ROC'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('CapRed') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%REALIZED CURR GL%' THEN 'CapRd GL'
                ELSE 'unmapped'
            END                                     AS transaction_type,            
            fin.credit_amount_portfolio_currency-fin.debit_amount_portfolio_currency     AS total_amount_pc,
            fin.credit_amount_quotation_currency-fin.debit_amount_quotation_currency     AS total_amount_qc
            FROM latest_trans trans
            INNER JOIN latest_finance_trans fin
                ON trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key = fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key
            INNER JOIN listed_ra_mp mp
                ON trans.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND trans.trade_date = mp.business_date
            LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers sec
               ON CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) = sec.business_date
              AND trans.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(sec.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
            WHERE trans.rn = 1
            AND fin.rn = 1     
    ),
    aggregated_trans AS (
        SELECT business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Gross Dividend' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS gross_div_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Gross Dividend' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS gross_div_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Dividend Taxes' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS div_taxes_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Dividend Taxes' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS div_taxes_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell ROC' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_roc_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell Costs' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_cos_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell GL' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_gl_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Net Purchase' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS net_purchase_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Purchase Costs' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_cost_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd ROC' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_roc_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd GL' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_gl_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell ROC' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_roc_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell Costs' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_cos_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell GL' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_gl_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Net Purchase' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS net_purchase_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Purchase Costs' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_cost_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd ROC' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_roc_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd GL' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_gl_qc
        FROM trans 
        WHERE transaction_type != 'unmapped'
        GROUP BY business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id     
    ),
    calculated_trans AS(
        SELECT business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id,
        gross_div_pc,gross_div_qc,div_taxes_pc,div_taxes_qc,
        net_purchase_qc,purchase_cost_qc,net_purchase_pc,purchase_cost_pc,
        sell_roc_pc, sell_cos_pc,sell_gl_pc,sell_roc_qc, sell_cos_qc,sell_gl_qc,
            net_purchase_pc + purchase_cost_pc AS gross_purchase_pc,
            sell_roc_pc + sell_cos_pc + sell_gl_pc AS net_sell_pc,
            cap_roc_pc + cap_gl_pc AS total_cap_pc,
            sell_roc_pc + sell_cos_pc + sell_gl_pc + net_purchase_pc + purchase_cost_pc + cap_roc_pc + cap_gl_pc AS net_cap_bal_pc,
            net_purchase_qc + purchase_cost_qc AS gross_purchase_qc,
            sell_roc_qc + sell_cos_qc + sell_gl_qc AS net_sell_qc,
            cap_roc_qc + cap_gl_qc AS total_cap_qc,
            sell_roc_qc + sell_cos_qc + sell_gl_qc + net_purchase_qc + purchase_cost_qc + cap_roc_qc + cap_gl_qc AS net_cap_bal_qc
        FROM aggregated_trans
    ),
    performance AS(
        SELECT business_date,
            model_portfolio_id,
            abor_security_id,
            cash_flow_reporting_currency,
            cash_flow_quotation_currency,
            clean_price,
            payments_quotation_currency,
            payments_reporting_currency,
            reallocation_payments_quotation_currency,
            reallocation_payments_reporting_currency,
            nominal_value_buy_sell_during_the_day
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation
    )

          AND trans.reconciliation_status = 'Reconcilable'
          AND trans.business_transaction_code in ('Sell','CASell','SellInternal','Buy','CABuy','BuyInternal','CapRed','Exchange Offer','Dividend','Rights Distribution','GenCost')
          AND CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
    ),

        SELECT fin.*, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (

          AND fin.gl_account_name != 'CASH BALANCE'

        SELECT
            trans.trade_date                        AS business_date,

            sec.bloomberg_unique_id                 AS bb_unique_id,
            CASE
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'Sell ROC'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%TRNS BRKR COMM COST%' THEN 'Sell Costs'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%REALIZED%' THEN 'Sell GL'

            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd GL' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_gl_qc
        FROM trans 
        WHERE transaction_type != 'unmapped'
        GROUP BY business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id     
    ),
    calculated_trans AS(
        SELECT business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id,
        gross_div_pc,gross_div_qc,div_taxes_pc,div_taxes_qc,
        net_purchase_qc,purchase_cost_qc,net_purchase_pc,purchase_cost_pc,
        sell_roc_pc, sell_cos_pc,sell_gl_pc,sell_roc_qc, sell_cos_qc,sell_gl_qc,

            sell_roc_qc + sell_cos_qc + sell_gl_qc + net_purchase_qc + purchase_cost_qc + cap_roc_qc + cap_gl_qc AS net_cap_bal_qc
        FROM aggregated_trans

    performance AS(

SELECT ds.* FROM ( WITH
    listed_ra_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name,
            InvestmentStructureLevel5
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                InvestmentStructureLevel3 IN ('Infrastructure','Real Estate','Sustainable Energy Group')
                  AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure','Listed Real Estate','Power and Renewables Group')
                  AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM','Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM','Power Generation')
                  AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')
                   OR model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104','MPRSBE0', 'MPR1000279', 'MPR1000328', 'MPR1000200', 'MPAR100041')
                )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
    ),
    latest_trans AS (
        SELECT trans.*, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY trans.abor_security_number, trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key
                    ORDER BY trans.changed_date DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions trans
        WHERE trans.transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
        --  AND trans.requested_transaction_status = 'Final GL'
          AND trans.reconciliation_status = 'Reconcilable'
          AND trans.business_transaction_code in ('Sell','CASell','SellInternal','Buy','CABuy','BuyInternal','CapRed','Exchange Offer','Dividend','Rights Distribution','GenCost')
          AND CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
    ),
    latest_finance_trans AS (
        SELECT fin.*, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key, fin.finance_transaction_index
                    ORDER BY fin.extract_time DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM finance_accounting.scd_finance_transactions fin
        WHERE fin.finance_scheme LIKE '%EQTY%'
          AND fin.accounting_framework_id = 'MAIN'
          AND fin.gl_account_name != 'CASH BALANCE'
          AND fin.gl_account_name NOT LIKE '%DUE%'
          AND fin.booking_type != 'Payment reconciliation'
    ),
    trans AS (
        SELECT
            trans.trade_date                        AS business_date,
            trans.model_portfolio_id                AS model_portfolio_id,
            sec.bloomberg_unique_id                 AS bb_unique_id,
            CASE
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'Sell ROC'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%TRNS BRKR COMM COST%' THEN 'Sell Costs'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%REALIZED%' THEN 'Sell GL'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Buy','BuyInternal','CABuy','Exchange Offer') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'Net Purchase'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Buy','BuyInternal','CABuy') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%TRNS BRKR COMM COST%' THEN 'Purchase Costs'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Dividend') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%DIVIDEND INC%' THEN 'Gross Dividend'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Dividend') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%TAX EXP%' THEN 'Dividend Taxes'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('CapRed') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'CapRd ROC'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('CapRed') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%REALIZED CURR GL%' THEN 'CapRd GL'
                ELSE 'unmapped'
            END                                     AS transaction_type,            
            fin.credit_amount_portfolio_currency-fin.debit_amount_portfolio_currency     AS total_amount_pc,
            fin.credit_amount_quotation_currency-fin.debit_amount_quotation_currency     AS total_amount_qc
            FROM latest_trans trans
            INNER JOIN latest_finance_trans fin
                ON trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key = fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key
            INNER JOIN listed_ra_mp mp
                ON trans.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND trans.trade_date = mp.business_date
            LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers sec
               ON CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) = sec.business_date
              AND trans.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(sec.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
            WHERE trans.rn = 1
            AND fin.rn = 1     
    ),
    aggregated_trans AS (
        SELECT business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Gross Dividend' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS gross_div_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Gross Dividend' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS gross_div_qc,

            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell Costs' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_cos_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell GL' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_gl_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Net Purchase' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS net_purchase_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Purchase Costs' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_cost_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd ROC' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_roc_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd GL' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_gl_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell ROC' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_roc_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell Costs' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_cos_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell GL' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_gl_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Net Purchase' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS net_purchase_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Purchase Costs' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_cost_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd ROC' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_roc_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd GL' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_gl_qc
        FROM trans 
        WHERE transaction_type != 'unmapped'
        GROUP BY business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id     
    ),
    calculated_trans AS(
        SELECT business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id,
        gross_div_pc,gross_div_qc,div_taxes_pc,div_taxes_qc,
        net_purchase_qc,purchase_cost_qc,net_purchase_pc,purchase_cost_pc,
        sell_roc_pc, sell_cos_pc,sell_gl_pc,sell_roc_qc, sell_cos_qc,sell_gl_qc,

            sell_roc_qc + sell_cos_qc + sell_gl_qc + net_purchase_qc + purchase_cost_qc + cap_roc_qc + cap_gl_qc AS net_cap_bal_qc
        FROM aggregated_trans
    ),
    performance AS(

            cash_flow_quotation_currency,

SELECT "business_date", "pool_name", "account_name", "investment_structure_level_01", "investment_structure_level_02", "external_reporting_dm_em", "external_reporting_region", "external_reporting_country", "external_reporting_assetmix", "business_date_string", "year_month", "is_month_end", "is_fiscalyear_end", "external_reporting_dm_em_region", "external_reporting_currency", "total_market_value_pc"
FROM (with lt_base as (
	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, date_add( 'month', 9, mhl.business_date ) as fiscal_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name_unified as pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.external_reporting_dm_em
		, mhl.external_reporting_region
		, mhl.external_reporting_country
		, mhl.external_reporting_assetmix
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from (
		select
			*
			, case -- per request of Doug to use special handling to make pool names consistent over history in short term until they have a long-term fix
				when pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Core Pool' ) then 'Core'
				when pool_name in ( 'Supplementary', 'Supplementary Pool' ) then 'Supplementary'
				else pool_name
			  end pool_name_unified
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
	) mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end
			  ) acpp_unitized_percentage
		from (
			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select
					  business_date 
					, max( extract_time ) as latest_extract_time -- select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only
				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name_unified = unitization.pool_name
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
		and mhl.id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
			  'MIN1000042'
			, 'NPTESTA'
			, 'NPTESTB'
			, 'PMIEMELTCS'
			, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
			, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
			, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
		) 
		and mhl.business_date >= cast( '2019-03-31' as date ) -- only pull from F20 onwards because unitization data only goes back to 2018-10-01
), lt_final as (
	select
		  lt_base.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case 
			when business_date = ( max( business_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from business_date ), extract( month from business_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_month_end
		, case 
			when fiscal_date = ( max( fiscal_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from fiscal_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_fiscalyear_end
		, case 
			when external_reporting_country in ( 'CHINA', 'HONG KONG', 'TAIWAN', 'MACAO' ) then 'Greater China'
			when external_reporting_country = 'INDIA' then 'India'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'United States', 'Canada' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region = 'Europe' then 'DM Europe'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' then 'Other DM'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'Latin America' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' then 'Other EM'
		  end external_reporting_dm_em_region
		, case -- temporary logic to coalesce currency of exposure code and parent quoted currency until fix is implemented in LT product
			when coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code ) in ( 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR', 'CNY', 'JPY', 'INR', 'BRL' ) then coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code )
			else 'Other'
		  end external_reporting_currency
	from
		lt_base
), lt_final_agg as (
	select *
	from (
		select
			  lt_agg.business_date
			--, lt_agg.fiscal_date
			, lt_agg.pool_name
			, lt_agg_unpivot.account_name
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_01
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_02
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_assetmix
			, lt_agg.business_date_string
			, lt_agg.year_month
			, lt_agg.is_month_end
			, lt_agg.is_fiscalyear_end
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency
			--, lt_agg.total_market_value_pc as total_market_value_pc_orig
			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (
			select
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from
				lt_final
			group by 
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
		) lt_agg
		cross join unnest( -- UNVPIVOT ACCOUNTS
			array [ 'bCPP', 'aCPP' ],
			array [ bcpp_total_market_value_pc, acpp_total_market_value_pc ]
		) lt_agg_unpivot ( account_name, total_market_value_pc )
	)
	where total_market_value_pc is not null and total_market_value_pc != 0
)

        ('PEXPOC'), ('PSUITC'), ('RINC'), ('SCOC'), ('WHT'),

    --------------------------------------
FROM
    credit_investment_private_trusted_uat.cashflows_all_transactions transactions
LEFT JOIN
    reference_uat.ci_sentry_security securities
ON
    transactions.security_identifier = securities.security_identifier
WHERE
    CAST(transactions.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-26' AS DATE)
AND
    CAST(securities.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-26' AS DATE)
AND
    TRY_CAST('2025-06-26' AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE (securities.start_date) AND DATE(securities.end_date)
--AND
--  TRY_CAST(transactions.trade_date AS DATE) >= TRY_CAST('2025-06-26' AS DATE)
-- TODO: confirm if this is just because there is no underlying data
-- or there is problem in the logic
AND
    transactions.transaction_type = 'transaction'
AND
    transactions.is_cancelled = 'False'
AND
    (    settlement_date = ''
  --    OR TRY_CAST(settlement_date AS DATE) >= TRY_CAST('2025-06-26' AS DATE)
    )
AND
    -- Filter out the transaction codes that should be excluded
    transactions.transaction_code NOT IN (SELECT code FROM excluded_transaction_codes)

CAST(d.cs01 AS decimal(22,6)) as cs01,

from (
select benchmark_name, node_name, node_level, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, analytic_value as "var95", run_id from

where business_date = '2025-06-26'

(select benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, node_name, node_level, analytic_value as "mean", run_id from
radar_reporting_prod.benchmark_analytic_mean 
where business_date = '2025-06-26' and analytic_type = 'MEAN_10YR'
) as b on var.run_id = b.run_id and b.benchmark_name = var.benchmark_name   
and b.node_name = var.node_name and b.hierarchy_type = var.hierarchy_type and b.hierarchy_node = var.hierarchy_node
and b.node_level = var.node_level
left join 
(select benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, node_name, node_level, analytic_value as "vol", run_id from
radar_reporting_prod.benchmark_analytic_vol 
where business_date = '2025-06-26' and analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR'

WITH

        SELECT
            DATE('2025-06-23')               AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE))   AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-06-23')
          AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
          AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_re_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                    InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Real Estate'
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Listed Real Estate')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel6 IN ('Portfolio Enhancement DM', 'Portfolio Enhancement EM')
                AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')
                 OR model_portfolio IN ('')
            )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(

SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "business_date_int", "year_month", "period_sorted"
FROM (with asset_class_base as (
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, node_name as pbor_node_name
		, "level" as split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_rc' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_lc' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%_qtd_%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%_3m_%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%_fytd_%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%_1y_roll_%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%_4yp_%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%_5y_roll_%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, node_name 
			, "level"
			, time_weighted_return_rc
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			, last_update 
		from 
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where
			dataset_id = 'ASSETCL_CMB'
			and periods_per_year = 12
			and "level" = 1
			and node_name != 'Excluded' -- Per Michael Brown from Performance team, the Excluded node should be excluded from reporting
	) pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_rc'

			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_rc
			, time_weighted_return_lc

/* cppi::ba58463548547aaf5460c9a08d97ac550bc23206f935eab1a845d7b0c8d6eeda */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 27
		AND hour between 13 and 14
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-27 13:11:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'

			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y

			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd

			union all

				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
